0022600111.text: The Suns (0-1) host the Warriors (0-1) in Phoenix's second game of the season, with Phoenix 5th in the Pacific and Golden State 3rd, both one game back, and the two teams ranked 15th and 13th in the West. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery for Phoenix, and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), all listed as out, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after a 101-97 Phoenix loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026, and a 2025-26 season series the Suns lost 1-3.
